title: Laplace expansion along column k writes a determinant covector in the form w♭∧α with w = g_k
statement: Let P, d ∈ ℕ, n := d+1, g_0, …, g_d ∈ ℝ^P and k ∈ Fin n. Let γ be an n-covector on ℝ^P with γ(u) = det(⟨g_b, u_a⟩)_{a,b ∈ Fin n} for all u ∈ (ℝ^P)^n (entry ⟨g_b, u_a⟩ in row a, column b). Then there is a d-covector α on ℝ^P such that, for all u = (u_0, …, u_d), γ(u) = Σ_{i=0}^{d} (−1)^i ⟨g_k, u_i⟩ α(u_0, …, û_i, …, u_d). Here (u_0, …, û_i, …, u_d) = removeNth i u is u with the i-th entry deleted.
lean_statement: ∀ (P d : ℕ) (g : Fin (d + 1) → Euclid P) (k : Fin (d + 1)) (γ : Covector (Euclid P) (d + 1)), (∀ u : Fin (d + 1) → Euclid P, γ u = Matrix.det (Matrix.of fun a b => inner ℝ (g b) (u a))) → ∃ α : Covector (Euclid P) d, ∀ u : Fin (d + 1) → Euclid P, γ u = ∑ i : Fin (d + 1), (-1 : ℝ) ^ (i : ℕ) * (inner ℝ (g k) (u i) * α (i.removeNth u))
